div.head: Ordal 4.2
div.ab: 7 na béte nán man þæt fýr na læng, þonne man þa halgunge ongínne; ac licge þæt isen uppan þam gledan oðþæt þa æftemestan coll'; lecge hit man syððan uppan þam stápelan.
Et nemo faciat ignem diucius quam benediccio incipiat; sed iaceat ferrum super carbones usque ad ultimam collectam; postea mittatur super staplos.
and na béte nán man þæt fýr na læng, þonne man þa halgunge ongínne; ac licge þæt isen uppan þam gledan, oð ðæt þa æftemestan coll.; lecge hit man syððan uppan þam stápelan,
And no one shall continue to make up the fire after the consecration has begun, but the iron shall lie upon the embers until the last collect. Then it shall be laid upon the post,
Und niemand schüre das Feuer länger, sobald man [der Priester] die Weihe beginnt; aber das Eisen liege auf den glühenden Kohlen bis zur letzten Collecte; alsdann werde es auf die Pfähle hinaufgelegt.
And let no one stoke the fire any longer once [the priest] begins the consecration; but let the iron lie on the glowing coals until the last collect; then let it be laid up on the stakes.
div.note: H's ‘læng’ was altered to ‘længe’. Toller takes ‘stapel’ as ‘the stake’; compare 1a and 5.1.
